source_condition: Oversight must include independence from management and oversight of development and performance of internal control; document expertise and challenge of management.
procedure_and_test: Inspect governing-body composition, conflicts and minutes challenging a control failure; a meeting calendar alone cannot demonstrate oversight.
activation: Before relying on the affected requirement for the actual selected service and role.

source_condition: Translate objectives into reporting lines, delegated authority and responsibilities across entities, locations and outsourced functions.
procedure_and_test: Trace a cross-site escalation from executor through delegated authority to governing oversight; test a conflicting assignment.
activation: Before relying on the affected requirement for the actual selected service and role.

source_condition: Information used by controls must be relevant and sufficiently reliable, timely, complete and accurate for the objective.
procedure_and_test: Reconcile a control report to its originating system, transformation logic, excluded records and data-quality exceptions; count reconciliation alone does not establish accuracy.
activation: Before relying on the affected requirement for the actual selected service and role.

source_condition: Specify objectives clearly enough to identify and assess related risks; bind service commitments and system requirements to those objectives.
procedure_and_test: Compare accepted commitments to risk objectives and tolerances; challenge a vague availability objective that cannot be measured.
activation: Before relying on the affected requirement for the actual selected service and role.

source_condition: Identify and analyze risks across the entity and its dependencies as the basis for risk management.

activation: Before relying on the affected requirement for the actual selected service and role.

source_condition: Consider fraud in assessing achievement of objectives, including incentives, opportunities, rationalization and management override.
procedure_and_test: Inspect fraud scenarios beyond external intrusion; trace an override or dishonest reporting scenario to mitigation and review.
activation: Before relying on the affected requirement for the actual selected service and role.

source_condition: Identify changes that could significantly affect internal control, including business model, external environment and leadership.
procedure_and_test: Select a changed provider or service and verify a timely risk reassessment and resulting procedure change, including a decision that no change is needed.
activation: Before relying on the affected requirement for the actual selected service and role.

source_condition: Select and perform ongoing or separate evaluations to determine whether control components are present and functioning.
procedure_and_test: Compare the evaluation plan with risk, change and evaluator objectivity; inspect an ongoing monitoring gap and an independently performed evaluation.
activation: Before relying on the affected requirement for the actual selected service and role.

source_condition: Evaluate and communicate deficiencies in time for corrective action, including senior management and governance when appropriate.

activation: Before relying on the affected requirement for the actual selected service and role.

source_condition: Select control activities that reduce risk to acceptable levels, including segregation or justified alternative activities where segregation is impracticable.

activation: Before relying on the affected requirement for the actual selected service and role.

source_condition: Select technology control activities supporting objectives across infrastructure, access and acquisition/development/maintenance.

activation: Before relying on the affected requirement for the actual selected service and role.

source_condition: Deploy control activities through policies and procedures that assign timely execution, competent personnel, correction and reassessment.

activation: Before relying on the affected requirement for the actual selected service and role.

source_condition: Protect information assets through logical access architecture, authentication and authorization, including privileged paths and credentials.

activation: Before relying on the affected requirement for the actual selected service and role.

source_condition: Register and authorize users before credentials/access are issued and remove credentials when access is no longer authorized.

source_condition: Authorize, modify and remove resource access based on responsibilities, least privilege and segregation of duties.

activation: Before relying on the affected requirement for the actual selected service and role.

source_condition: Restrict physical access to facilities and protected information assets to authorized personnel.

source_condition: End protection of physical assets only after data and software cannot be read or recovered, when no longer needed for objectives.
